changelog: Fixed entrance door heading and raycast normal direction so INTERIOR strictly points into the room and EXTERIOR points to the street.
Added [F] keybind in door setup to instantly flip orientation 180 degrees.
Re-anchored 3D grid Y-axis to the door threshold (Y = 0.0) so interior floors and walls snap cleanly without exterior overlap.
Added solid opaque matte dark studio floor mesh under Z = 2500m to eliminate city lights and ground visibility.
Automatically suppressed GTA radar and street name HUD overlays during calibration and studio editing.
